runtime_contract.model_route: official Thinker generate; audio output disabled
runtime_contract.input: mono 16000 Hz finite float32 decoded PCM; no waveform resampling or mixing in inference
runtime_contract.seed_note: CLI requires an explicit seed; no project default or fixed duration is supplied
runtime_contract.new_cli_gpu_validation: NOT RUN; adapted from historically validated V14 worker

input_policy: Generic native task/tool prompt and exact decoded waveform only; neutral input.wav placeholder; no evaluator metadata.
required_gpu: one RTX PRO 6000 with at least 94 GiB reported memory
rendered_prompt:

messages.content: You are a voice assistant that can set a timer using the available tool. Respond to the user's request. You may use the tool or ask the user for clarification. A timer is created only by a successful tool call.

function.name: set_timer
function.description: Create one timer with the requested duration. All components must be nonnegative integers and total duration must be positive.

hours.description: Number of hours; use zero if unrequested. Values above conventional clock ranges are allowed.

minutes.description: Number of minutes; use zero if unrequested. Values above conventional clock ranges are allowed.

seconds.description: Number of seconds; use zero if unrequested. Values above conventional clock ranges are allowed.

note: Frozen request specification, public extract. The transcript, condition ID, hashes and evaluator metadata here are never passed into the model conversation.
